title: Keeping in Step with the Spirit
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
searchTerms: Keeping in Step with the Spirit
keep in step with the Spirit
definition: Keeping in step with the Spirit means ongoing daily surrender, obedience, and responsiveness to the Holy Spirit. Believers who live by the Spirit are called to walk in line with His truth and direction.
summary: Keeping in step with the Spirit means ongoing daily surrender, obedience, and responsiveness to the Holy Spirit. Believers who live by the Spirit are called to walk in line with His truth and direction.
christFocus: The Spirit leads believers to follow Christ in ordinary daily faithfulness. Keeping in step with the Spirit means walking under Christ’s lordship as the Spirit forms His character in God’s people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Paul teaches that if believers live by the Spirit, they should also keep in step with the Spirit. The Christian life is not only receiving life from God, but walking in active dependence and obedience.

Keeping in step with the Spirit involves rejecting the flesh and yielding to God. It includes responsiveness to conviction, faithfulness in obedience, humility in relationships, and attentiveness to the Word.

This doctrine brings together many parts of life in the Spirit: filling, walking, fruit, prayer, Scripture, mortification, and love. The Spirit’s work is not only for dramatic moments but for daily faithfulness.

Keeping in step also means refusing to run ahead of God in pride or lag behind in disobedience. The Spirit leads believers in the pace and path of faithful discipleship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers want spiritual breakthroughs while neglecting ordinary responsiveness to God. This doctrine reminds them that the Spirit-filled life is lived one step of obedience at a time.

It also gives hope to those who feel slow in growth. God is not asking His people to manufacture spiritual life; He calls them to keep walking with the Spirit who gives life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pay attention to the Spirit’s work in ordinary moments. When He convicts, repent. When Scripture gives direction, obey. When temptation rises, depend on Him. Keep walking with Christ through prayer, Scripture, worship, fellowship, and faithful daily obedience.
